$comment: Every hostname that may appear anywhere under src/. check-egress.mjs fails CI on any other host, comments included. Egress hosts must also be in src/net/egress.ts; redirect-URI hosts are places the user's browser goes, never the Worker.

egress.www.googleapis.com: JWKS (/oauth2/v3/certs) and the single Gmail scope string

redirect-uris.accounts.google.com: the browser is sent here to sign in; the Worker never fetches it
redirect-uris.localhost: loopback redirect (Claude Code CIMD, local dev)
